title: Guest Fee Schedule: Service Fee Rates, Fee Bases and Rounding on Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Guest Fee Schedule

The guest service fee and the occupancy tax on every reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category are computed on fixed bases at the rates below. The long-stay threshold in the same schedule decides which stays are booked under Long-Term.

## Rates by cancellation policy

| Cancellation policy | Guest service fee on a split-fee stay | Guest service fee on a host-only-fee stay | Long-stay threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible | 14.20% | 0.00% | 28 nights |
| Moderate | 14.20% | 0.00% | 28 nights |
| Limited | 14.20% | 0.00% | 28 nights |
| Firm | 14.20% | 0.00% | 28 nights |
| Strict | 14.20% | 0.00% | 28 nights |
| Super Strict 30 Days | 14.20% | 0.00% | 28 nights |
| Super Strict 60 Days | 14.20% | 0.00% | 28 nights |
| Long-Term | 12.00% | 0.00% | 28 nights |

- The **guest service fee on a split-fee stay** is the percent of the service-fee base charged as the guest service fee when the stay was booked with the split fee structure.
- The **guest service fee on a host-only-fee stay** is the percent of the service-fee base charged as the guest service fee when the stay was booked with the host-only fee structure.
- The **long-stay threshold** is the number of nights at or above which a stay is booked under Long-Term regardless of the listing's chosen policy: a stay of 28 nights or more is Long-Term; a stay of 27 nights is not.

## Bases and rounding (all eight policies)

| Item | Setting for Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days and Long-Term |
|---|---|
| Service-fee base | nightly subtotal, cleaning fee, pet fee and extra-guest fee |
| Occupancy-tax base | nightly subtotal, cleaning fee, pet fee and extra-guest fee |
| Rounding | nearest cent, half up, applied per component to every computed component amount |

## Worked figures (hypothetical bases)

| Stay | Service-fee base | Rate | Guest service fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Moderate, split fee | 1,000.00 | 14.20% | 142.00 |
| Long-Term, split fee | 1,000.00 | 12.00% | 120.00 |
| Firm, host-only fee | 1,000.00 | 0.00% | 0.00 |
| Strict, split fee | 333.33 | 14.20% | 47.33 (47.33286 rounded half up to the cent) |
